about: What is wrong today in the game's own sources, and tolerated by the guard (check_game in tools/check_suite.py). A file is named relative to unity/PryingEyes/Assets/_PryingEyes. An entry is deleted in the commit that fixes its violation (the guard fails with GAME_BASELINE_STALE until then) and is never added without a reason a reviewer accepts: a new violation fails the guard. docs/engineering/suite-architecture.md says what each rule is for.

GAME_PRODUCTION_NAMES_TEST.reason: CoopGame hands the CoopKind.Test messages to CoopTest.OnNet and starts the two-process scenarios through CoopTest.Wanted and CoopTest.Ensure. CoopTest is not wrapped, so the reference compiles in every build. It goes when the co-op scenarios move to the harness (T08) or the tests to an assembly of their own (T17).

GAME_TEST_NOT_EXCLUDED.reason: Never wrapped, and CoopGame.cs names CoopTest (see GAME_PRODUCTION_NAMES_TEST), so wrapping the class would break a distribution build until that reference goes. The three files of the partial class are wrapped together, after it.
